articles.title: A’ja Wilson confronts Fever fan after heated exchange during Aces game
articles.summary: A new angle shows just how intense A’ja Wilson’s confrontation with a Fever fan became. After getting tangled up with Sophie Cunningham following a physical foul, Wilson got to her feet and spotted a spectator two rows behind the basket pointing and shouting at her. She moved toward the fan before teammates and officials stepped in. Arena security determined that the spectator had not violated the fan code of conduct and he was not removed from his seat. Wilson later said that regardless of what was said, no fan should be pointing at or yelling at a player because she considers it unacceptable.
